Ello is an AI tutor for reading and math, ages 5 to 9 (Kinder to 3rd grade). Your child reads and talks out loud. Ello listens to every word and teaches in the moment.

Start free. The Free plan includes daily lessons, and your first week of Ello Unlimited is on us. No credit card.

88% of children read more with Ello.*
Named one of TIME's Best Inventions. Rated by Common Sense Media. Featured on Good Morning America.

HOW ELLO TEACHES
• It listens. When your child stumbles on a word, Ello hears it and helps them sound it out instead of saying the word for them.
• It talks back. After a story, Ello asks what happened, listens to the answer, and responds to what your child said.
• It explains math. Ello talks through each step out loud, from counting to multiplication, and lets your child find the answer.
• It starts at your child's level. Ello places your child in reading and math, and you can change the level anytime in Settings.

CREATE A STORY
Your child makes up a story. Ello turns it into a real book with pictures, then teaches them to read it.

BUILT FOR FAMILIES
• Up to 4 children on one account, each with their own level, stars, and books.
• A parent dashboard with lessons completed, words read, and stars earned.
• Texts that share the funny, sweet things your child says to Ello.
• No ads.

BUILT BY TEACHERS
Thirty-seven teachers and learning researchers built Ello.

WHAT PARENTS SAY
"My son is shy about attempting to read out loud with me, but he loves reading out loud with Ello!" (App Store review)
"It's actually engaging with my son and listening to what he says and correcting and encouraging him." (App Store review)

PLANS
• Free: daily reading and math lessons, shared by every child on the account.
• Ello Unlimited: unlimited learning for every child and full parent reports. Optional subscription, billed monthly or yearly.
• Every family gets Ello Unlimited free for their first 7 days.

*Survey of Ello families.

Questions? support@ello.com

How many acres is it? Where are the property lines? How many fence posts, tons of gravel or bags of mulch does the job take? Tap the corners on a crisp satellite map and AreaMap shows you.

PROPERTY LINES ON THE MAP
County lot lines over the satellite map. Tap any lot for its size, side lengths and address, or measure the whole lot in one tap. Plan view draws clean lines and buildings when trees hide the ground.

MEASURE BY TAPPING OR WALKING
Search an address and tap the corners, or walk the boundary with GPS, even with the screen locked. Drag corners, cut out ponds and buildings, and see every side labeled in feet.

MATERIALS ESTIMATE FOR THE JOB
Turn the shape into a shopping list: fence posts, rails, chain link and gates, gravel in tons and truckloads, mulch, sod, seed, lime, concrete, sealcoat, hydroseed, roofing, snow and more.

QUOTES YOUR CLIENTS CAN READ
Price the job with your own rates and send a clean quote or PDF report with the map, measurements and your logo.

KNOW THE LAND BEFORE YOU BID (PRO+)
FEMA flood zones, wetlands, USDA soils, 2-ft contours and slope on the map and on every lot card, plus the owner, assessed value, last sale, tax and building details from county records where available.

SAVE AND EXPORT
Save measurements with names, notes and photos. Export KML for Google Earth, GPX, GeoJSON, CSV or a map image.

Built for fence, landscaping, paving, concrete and snow contractors, farmers, landowners and anyone who needs to know how big a piece of land is and what it takes.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
AreaMap is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, Thai, Romanian and Ukrainian, and shows hectares and meters wherever they're the norm.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
You can explore the map and draw shapes for free. Measurement results, saving, walking a boundary, property lines, reports, exports, materials and quotes need AreaMap Pro; map layers, owner names, property values and sales need AreaMap Pro+; client reports, cut/fill and drainage, and the AI preview need AreaMap Max. Plans are billed yearly or monthly; the price for your country, and any free trial, are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the trial ends if you start one. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://areamap.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://areamap.app/privacy

AreaMap measurements come from map imagery and GPS and are estimates. Property lines and county records are shown where available and are approximate. They are not a legal survey. For boundary disputes, sales or permits, use a licensed surveyor.

Everyone's sleepmaxxing. Almost nobody's measuring it. Somnr turns your iPhone and Apple Watch into a real sleep tracker, scores every night out of 100, and hands you the exact plan to fix it.

Track with just your phone on the mattress or nightstand, or pair your Apple Watch for even sharper, all-night detection. Your choice.

TRACK YOUR SLEEP, PHONE OR WATCH
Somnr measures your whole night:
→ Full hypnogram of deep, core, REM and awake, hour by hour
→ Time asleep, efficiency, awakenings, restlessness
→ Snore detection and sound analysis in Nightstand mode
→ Motion-based detection in Boost mode, phone on the mattress
→ Apple Watch support for higher-accuracy, all-night tracking
→ Your night live on the Lock Screen while you sleep
Wake up to a complete breakdown of how you actually slept.

WAKE UP AT THE RIGHT MOMENT
The smart alarm reads your sleep and wakes you in your lightest window before your target time, so you get up clear instead of groggy.

YOUR SLEEP SCORE
→ Scored out of 100, ranked Tier S to F
→ Built from the factors that actually move sleep: timing, consistency, caffeine, recovery, circadian rhythm
→ Your verdict, no fluff, in seconds

YOUR OPTIMAL DAY
Every morning, Somnr builds the day your sleep is actually asking for:
→ When your peak focus hits
→ Your best workout window
→ Your last-coffee deadline
→ Tonight's ideal bedtime
→ Your recovery window
Not a generic template. Your day, from your data.

LOG YOUR CRASHES AND THE APP LEARNS YOUR PATTERN
Crash at 3 PM? Somnr logs it. After a week it tells you when you crash most, and warns you 30 minutes before. Your own sleep journal, talking back. No AI marketing, just your data.

WATCH YOUR SLEEP IMPROVE
→ See how old your sleep makes your energy
→ Your most-improved factors, highlighted
→ Your full 30-day trend curve and night history
→ Before/after photo, stored locally, never shared, never uploaded

PRIVACY-FIRST
→ Your data stays on your iPhone
→ Apple Health read-only access
→ Before/after photos never leave your device
→ No account required to start

WHY SOMNR
Most sleep apps hand you numbers you can't read. Somnr gives you a story: how good your sleep really is, what's wrecking it, what's fixing it, and the exact plan to sleepmaxx it. Fix your sleep and sharper focus, more energy and a more rested face follow. No opaque scores. No automated coaching pretending to know you. Just your number, your data, and a clear plan.

SOMNR PRO
Somnr is free to download. Somnr Pro unlocks the full experience: night-by-night sleep tracking, your Sleep Score, the smart alarm, your Optimal Day, and full 30-day history.
Somnr Pro is an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. Prices may vary by region.

Terms of Use: https://somnr.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://somnr.app/privacy

Beyond the shared family calendar, Cubbily helps you manage everyday life with a shared grocery list, family to-dos, chores, and reminders—all synced across devices. SHARED CALENDAR THAT’S EASY & CLEAR
	•	See everyone’s plans at a glance with colour-coded day, week, month, and task views
	•	Create events in seconds with powerful repeats and reminders that reach the right people
	•	Add events faster with AI—use your voice or a photo of a schedule
	•	Avoid conflicts by sharing work shifts/rotas, school events, practices, and appointments in one place
	•	Subscribe & sync with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, and others to keep everything up to date
	•	Add meal plans as calendar events to keep dinner on track

	•	Perfect for firefighters, nurses, paramedics, police, and other shift workers

	•	Assign items and get notified when things get done—right inside your family calendar
	•	A built-in task manager so plans and tasks live in one place

“BIG DAYS” & FAMILY MILESTONES

“LITTLE THINGS” CARE NOTES

MULTIPLE FAMILIES, ONE ACCOUNT

ALWAYS IN SYNC, ACROSS DEVICES
	•	Everyone sees the same up-to-date schedule with automatic sync and reminders

WHO IT’S PERFECT FOR

	•	Homes with multiple kids (or home-school) that need conflict-free planning

Life doesn't always go to plan. Whether it's pressure at work, money worries, family life or just a tough week, Wisdom Wellbeing brings support for your mind, body and everyday life together in one app.
 
Wisdom Wellbeing is ORCHA Assured, independently assessed for clinical assurance, data privacy and usability.
 
CHECK IN WITH YOURSELF
Log your mood each day and build your check-in streak. Wisdom Wellbeing responds to how you're feeling, from a journaling prompt that matches your mood to extra support when things have been tough for a few days. Reflect in the Positive You journal and spot patterns over time with Your Insights.
 
SUPPORT WHEN YOU NEED IT
Having a hard moment? Support Moments asks how you're feeling, whether that's low, anxious, overwhelmed or exhausted, and guides you to short, calming resources. If you're still not feeling better, it shows you how to speak to someone.
 
LEARN WITH WISDOM ACADEMY
Short, structured courses on topics such as sleep, stress and anxiety, setting boundaries and neurodiversity, including courses for managers and students. See how long each course takes before you start, test yourself with quick quizzes, and download a certificate when you finish.
 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS
Mini Health Checks help you check in on areas such as sleep, alcohol and fatigue, and see how your result compares with last time. 4-Week Plans help you build healthy daily habits around sleep, movement, eating, screen time and more.
 
LOOK AFTER YOUR BODY
Track your water, steps, sleep and activity, and set goals that work for you. Sync your steps and sleep automatically from Apple Health. Create or join leaderboard challenges for some friendly competition with colleagues.
 
EXPLORE RESOURCES
Relax with guided meditation, yoga and soothing soundscapes, get moving with fitness content, and find healthy recipes. Read practical articles on money, legal matters, parenting and family life, or listen to Wisdom Talks, our podcast series.
 
GET ANSWERS AND SUPPORT
Ask Wisdom AI, created by experts, for answers to common wellbeing questions and helpful resources at any time. When you'd rather talk to someone, go to Support to request a callback or, where available, message the team on WhatsApp.
 
PERKS AND DISCOUNTS
Where your organisation offers it, save on entertainment, gifts, days out and much more.
 
SIMPLE AND SECURE
Log in quickly with Face ID or Touch ID, or your organisation's single sign-on, and adjust accessibility settings to suit you.
 
Wisdom Wellbeing is available through your employer or organisation, and some features depend on your plan. If you're not sure whether you have access, check with your scheme administrator, or contact our Customer Solutions team at customer.solutions@wisdomwellbeing.com for help with your organisation code or logging in. To find out more about Wisdom Wellbeing for your organisation, contact sales@wisdomwellbeing.com.
 
Wisdom Wellbeing is not an emergency service. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call 999 or your local emergency number.

Simple Budget Planner is a calm, manual budget for you and your household. No bank login, no connected accounts, nothing automatic happening behind your back: you write down what you spend, and you always know what's left.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
• Your balance for the period, and Look ahead: where you'll be on any date, with the lowest point on the way
• What's left a day or this week, right on the Home screen
• A short recap at the end of every period, and your year in review

PLAN YOUR MONTH
• Give every category a budget, envelope-style, and see what's left at a glance
• Bills and recurring payments go out on the day you choose and count before they arrive, so "left to spend" is honest
• Monthly from your payday, twice a month (1st and 15th), weekly, or every 2 or 4 weeks
• A "Left to spend" widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, with amounts you can hide

TRACK IN SECONDS
• Add an expense in three taps with the quick keypad
• Edit anything in place, move entries between categories, undo a delete
• Search, filter and sort by date or by due date
• A gentle reminder if you forget, and a note that remembers its category

SAVE ON PURPOSE
• Savings goals with contributions and progress
• Money set aside is shown separately, never counted as spending

SHARE WITH YOUR HOUSEHOLD
• Invite your partner or family to the same budget
• Send your partner a link: they join in one tap, no account needed first
• Everyone sees the same numbers, on their own iPhone or iPad

SEE WHERE IT GOES
• Clear spending and income insights by category
• Money in against spent over the last 6 months
• Look back over any dates: a whole year, the last 3 months or your own range, with every entry in one list
• Every chart has a text summary and a table view

YOURS TO KEEP
• Export everything to CSV at any time, on every plan
• Works offline and syncs when you're back online
• Your data is never sold and never used for ads
• Lock the app with Face ID
• Siri and Shortcuts: add an expense without opening the app
• On iPhone and iPad, with two columns on the bigger screen

Simple Budget Planner is free to download and use. The free plan includes 40 entries for your household, or 80 when you share it, and every feature. Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription that removes the entry limit. One subscription covers your household through Family Sharing.

Bills to Budget is the modern checkbook register that helps you stay organized, track every bill, and know exactly what's cleared and what's still pending. If you've ever been surprised by a payment hitting your account at the wrong time, this app is for you.

FINALLY KNOW WHAT'S REALLY IN YOUR ACCOUNT

The biggest problem with online banking? It only shows what's cleared. Bills to Budget lets you mark payments as "Paid but not Cleared" — so you always know your true available balance, not just what the bank says. No more mental math. No more overdrafts from forgotten pending checks.

STAY AHEAD OF EVERY BILL

Add your bills once, and Bills to Budget reminds you before they're due. Mark a bill as paid, and it automatically resets for next month, next quarter, or whatever schedule you need. See everything organized by your pay schedule, so you always know what's due before your next paycheck arrives.

SEE YOUR FINANCIAL FUTURE

The calendar view shows your complete financial picture: upcoming bills, paydays, and projected balances all in one place. Spot problems days or weeks before they become stress. Know exactly how much you can afford to spend today.

- Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac with seamless iCloud sync
- Supports multiple accounts — checking, savings, credit cards

Track your expenses and make the most of your savings with Tracky’s automatic calculation of your remaining budget. This fast and easy budget tracking tool is suitable for everyone, regardless of their expertise in budget management. Rest assured, Tracky doesn't require any connection to your bank account, ensuring your data and privacy remain secure.

- Enjoy your savings

- No bank account needed

- Keep a history of your expenses
- Save time by reusing recurring budgets

Brili Routines is a visual planner and timekeeper that helps manage and gamify your tasks, designed to be the perfect organizer for the ADHD / ADD community.


Brili is based on the latest ADHD research and incorporates best practices from Cognitive Behavioural Therapy. Build well-designed routines that fit your unique way of living with ADHD to set out on your next adventure.

Create, schedule, manage, and complete your routines with Brili in an gamified and structured way that allows for the flexibility and fun you need to move through your daily tasks with ease.

With Brili, routines are brought to life as well-paced playlists. Consistent notifications nudge you to stay on track with your timed and scheduled routines. The calendar allows you to view your day and week, and customizable awards motivate you to grow over time. The Brili technique helps you manage your ADHD symptoms, avoid procrastination, keep your concentration and stick to a daily plan.

The app helps with the visualization of time to keep you on the quest at hand and up to date with your schedule. Brili’s unique visual clock automatically calculates the time left to complete all of your tasks, so you can better concentrate on what you are working on now.

Many individuals with ADHD have seen incredible benefits from Brili beyond just health and structure. Benefits may include improved mood, less compulsive behavior and a better ability to concentrate with fewer distractions.

Understand posture from the inside out.
The Posture app by Muscle & Motion turns your device into a powerful 3D learning platform that reveals the anatomy, biomechanics, and muscular patterns behind good (and poor) posture. Explore common postural faults, watch muscles activate in 3D, and learn how alignment influences movement, performance, and pain.

Whether you’re a therapist, trainer, movement educator, student, or someone working to improve your own posture, this app helps you see what’s really happening beneath the surface.

Why Physical Therapists, clinicians & movement professionals love it

- Makes complex posture concepts easy to understand through clear 3D animations
- Shows exactly which muscles are overactive, underactive, tight, or lengthened
- Helps explain posture to clients and patients far better than static images
- Reveals the biomechanics behind common faults like rounded shoulders, forward head, swayback, lordosis, kyphosis, and more
- Provides corrective exercises and movement strategies that professionals can use immediately

Key Features

• 3D Postural Analysis Library
Understand why issues like kyphosis, lordosis, or flat back develop. The app uses clear 3D visuals to show how muscular imbalances create each postural pattern, and provides guided exercises that can help you correct and improve them over time.

• Corrective Exercise Library
Access targeted strengthening and mobility exercises for improving alignment. 

• Biomechanical Principles Made Simple
See how the brain, muscles, and joints coordinate to maintain posture. Learn about load distribution, joint alignment, center of gravity, and functional stability, all visualized in 3D.

Who is this app for?
The Posture app is built for anyone who wants to understand and improve posture, including:

- Physiotherapists, chiropractors & rehab professionals
- Personal trainers & corrective exercise specialists
- Yoga, Pilates & movement teachers
- Kinesiology and physical therapy students
- University and college instructors
- Strength coaches & athletic trainers
- Massage therapists & bodyworkers
- Individuals working on posture, mobility, or pain reduction

Use it to assess posture, teach alignment, choose corrections, create programs, or simply deepen your understanding of human movement.

Free Access & Subscriptions
You can download the app and explore part of the posture content for free, including sample 3D lessons and corrective exercises.

To unlock the full library (including all posture analyses, 3D anatomy content, corrective exercises, and biomechanics videos) you can upgrade with an in-app subscription:
- Subscriptions give you full access to all videos, lessons, and 3D content for the duration of your plan.
- Subscriptions auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID settings.

You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on your device.


For full details:
Privacy Policy: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/terms-of-use/

Support
Have a question, feature request or need help with your subscription?
Our team is happy to help at info@muscleandmotion.com.

Add structure to your day with "Focus Sessions" that encourage you to complete goals, tasks, and help you divide your time into Focus, Break, and Prepare stages.

Pick from a selection of templates, including a simple timer, Pomodoro - inspired by the Pomodoro Technique, Flowmodoro - inspired by the Flowtime Technique, and other various sessions.

You can also create repeatable sessions specifically tailored to your needs. Add stages, set time limits, and much more.

Ultimately, Focused Work helps you be more accountable by reminding you to focus, reflect, and build healthy productivity habits by completing various daily goals.


**Core Features**

· A simple, powerful timer that keeps you on-task
Choose what to focus on. Start the timer. Get stuff done!

· Curated Basic Sessions to get started
Run a Pomodoro session, Flowmodoro session, or even just a simple timer

· Create Focus Sessions
Tailor them to your needs with a plethora of configurable options

· Reminders
Be reminded to stay focused, when to take breaks, and also to start a focus session!

· Reflection
Track what went well for you during your focus session and what you can improve upon

· Scratch Pad
Jot down thoughts that come to mind during your session and return to them after

· Daily Goals
Completing your daily focus goals earns you a streak and helps you form healthy productivity habits

· Statistics & Charts
Review recent productivity across the past week, month, and year

· Block Distractions
Select apps and websites you want to restrict access to during a session

· In-app Shortcuts Automation
Automatically perform actions as you progress through your session, such as turning on Focus

· Link with Toggl Track
Explore advanced time tracking by linking with Toggl to create time entries, assign projects and tags

· Productivity Export
Export completed sessions in CSV format


**iOS & iPadOS Features**

Focused Work is available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with extensive support for each platform;

· Live Activities
Control your session from the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island

· Interactive Widgets
Control your session, view daily goals, and start a session from the Home Screen

· Control Center Widgets
Start a session or access the Scratch Pad with Control Widgets

· StandBy
Interact with your session while iPhone is in StandBy

· Spotlight Search
Quick start and interact with sessions from search

· Focus Filters
Filter which sessions can be viewed & started based on the active Focus

· App Shortcuts & Siri
Start and interact with a session via various shortcuts that can also be linked together

· Picture-in-Picture
Show a floating timer above other apps with Picture-in-Picture mode

· Session Alerts on all devices
Start a session on one device and receive update alerts on others with Focused Work installed

· iCloud Syncing
Sync productivity stats & created sessions between devices

· Privacy Focused
Your data is securely stored and managed via iCloud. No account registration.

Mac Support, Share Sheet controls, App Icons, Keyboard Shortcuts, VoiceOver, Split View & Slide Over, Low Power Mode, Drag & Drop, Dark Mode, URL Schemes

leads.description:
Tiny Planner is a concise but powerful life management application that integrates tasks, to-do lists, reminders, calendars, notes, and shopping lists. All data is in one place without the need for additional applications. Furthermore, EverPlan supports syncing data between multiple iOS devices via iCloud.

Currently, all application functions are open and free without ads!

The powerful note-taking feature supports text, image, and voice notes, making it easy to record, organize, and capture your ideas.


Main features:
Tasks

- Organize and manage all tasks with task lists and time.
- Different types of tasks can be displayed in different colors.
- Support adding subtasks, setting reminder alarms, and loop properties within tasks.
- Easily copy tasks as events or notes with long press.

Calendar

- Quickly add tasks, events, and notes of the day by long-pressing on the calendar.
- Month view provides an intuitive way to view tasks and notes of the day.
- The calendar page can choose whether to display tasks and notes.
- Quickly switch between month view and schedule list view.

Notes

- Various text editing tools.
- Support inputting text, voice, and image, comprehensively recording every moment that is worth recording
- support attachments in formats such as PDF, Word, PPT, TXT,HTML .
- Support encrypting individual notebooks to protect privacy.
- Quickly convert events or tasks to notes with long press.


Our mission is to provide you with the best life management tool to make your daily life more convenient and efficient. If you encounter any difficulties or need help, we are more than willing to provide you with support and assistance. Please send an email to tinyplanner@fengge.io.
